aSkip.text: In Manhattan, uptown [A] local skips 72 St, 81 St-Museum of Natural History, 86 St, 96 St, 103 St, Cathedral Pkwy-110 St and 116 St
aSkip.description:
For service to these stations, take the [A] to 125 St and transfer to a downtown [A] or [D].

For service from these stations, take the [A] or [D] to 59 St-Columbus Circle and transfer to an uptown [A].

Schedule reminder: [A] skips these stations days and evenings.

Note: Downtown [D] runs local from 125 St to 59 St-Columbus Circle during this time.
